active_family: 663a bounded-IV state-aware normalized-innovation conditional law; first backend is AR flow matching but backend changes require protocol diagnostics
single_framework_candidate_gate: A framework candidate must freeze one recipe and evaluate it on iv_only, anchor_only, and joint. Allowed differences are input/output dimensionality, support transforms, input heads, decoder heads, and deterministic channel/group balancing. Scope-specific losses, loss weights, backend, prior, sampler, calibration layer, or glued separately sampled decks are not allowed for a framework claim.
current_framework_status: First frozen tri-scope baseline established in 688a: 674a/675a IV-only, 688a anchor-only, and 676a joint38 share the zero-center normalized-innovation AR flow recipe with rollout energy 0.2, channel-level energy 0.05, train samples 2, rollout steps 4, all train windows, no contrast, no AR1 prior. It is a real framework-lock baseline but not final deployable. 698b introduced the first promising successor data-object: innovation-score AR flow. Joint38 validation improved to 6/11 while panel realism survived, but iv_only and anchor_only have not yet been run under the frozen score-coordinate recipe, so it is not a validated framework candidate.
normalization_policy: support-aware encoded levels; daily encoded increments; history-only fixed EWMA/RMS scale with robust floor; zero center remains the deployable incumbent. 679a/680a falsified full EWMA mean centering as too deterministic even with rollout-energy repair; 681a falsified EWMA drift as an added conditioning feature because it still over-amplified drift/mean-reversion and damaged level/path allocation.
backend_switch_policy: Do not switch AR/one-shot, flow/diffusion/copula, or Transformer/other backbone until required audits classify the failure as backend failure rather than data framing, reconstruction, conditionality, diversity, dependency, or distribution shift.
research_axis_policy: Change one axis per iteration unless diagnostics prove coupling. Axes: data_object, temporal_factorization, backend, encoder, dependency_structure, calibration.
literature_search_policy: Search papers/official sources during diagnosis when a failure class repeats twice, a methodology/backend/encoder/temporal switch is considered, a normalization failure is not understood, local fixes are exhausted, or model limitation is about to be claimed.
current_bottleneck: Conditionality plus computational viability of score-coordinate rollout. Innovation-score factorization improves level/path law and preserves joint panel realism, but train-tail and validation still fail conditionality, coverage, regime coverage, and kurtosis. Full all-train rollout is also much slower because inverse score transforms run inside differentiable rollout.
last_result_summary: 698b implemented innovation_coordinate='score' in the generic state-aware normalized-innovation AR flow. Tests passed (24 passed). Joint38 validation at 96 samples improved from 676a's 5/11 to 6/11: cov90 0.780, conditional MAE +9.9%, level KS 18/25, median fraction 22/25, bias magnitude 23/25, corr/rank 0.942/1.292, mean-reversion ratio 0.925, pathwise KS 0.294. Joint panel survived: factor KS mean 0.102, factor KS pass 12/13, q99 pass 13/13, factor corr shape 0.862, IV-factor corr shape 0.893. Train-tail also scored 6/11 but still failed conditionality and coverage.
next_step_recommendation: Keep the score-coordinate factorization alive. Next minimal step: make score-coordinate rollout training computationally viable via vectorized/cached inverse innovation-score transform, then either continue full rollout training or run a controlled reduced-budget diagnostic. After the joint result is stable, evaluate the same frozen recipe on iv_only and anchor_only for the single-framework gate.
current_best_note: 510a/392a remain the historical short-frame best learned IV laws at 8/11. Within the clean general state-aware normalized-innovation family, 674a/675a remains the strongest IV-only candidate at 7/11. The frozen tri-scope baseline is 674a/675a IV-only + 688a anchor-only + 676a joint38. 698b is now the strongest clean native joint38 non-contrast score at 6/11 and improves over 676a's joint 5/11 while preserving anchor-factor panel realism, but it is not tri-scope validated yet.
oracle_feasibility_note: 435a reaches 11/11 only as a validation-future oracle upper bound; it is not a deployable or learned conditional scenario generator.
